perplexity_final_check.rationale: Terminal Perplexity check returned 20 results with only 1 URL overlapping the base providers, so 19 URLs are incrementally new recall. Primary pages for the MOLS catalogue and the specified-autotopism repository were opened and verified: the former stops at order 9 with only random order-10 pairs and a near-triple, the latter supplies examples rather than an exhaustive census. No decisive prior was found; provisional originality PASS and the complete public package are preserved.
